import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load the seed dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/Users/bytedance/Desktop/bench/seed_datasets/ecommerce/orders.csv')

# Rename columns to domain-appropriate but different names
column_mapping = {
    'order_id': 'transaction_id',
    'customer_id': 'client_id',
    'order_date': 'purchase_date',
    'category': 'product_type',
    'unit_price': 'price_per_unit',
    'quantity': 'units_sold',
    'total_amount': 'sales_value',
    'channel': 'purchase_channel',
    'returned': 'is_returned',
    'rating': 'customer_rating'
}
df.rename(columns=column_mapping, inplace=True)

# Inject a canary value into the data for contamination detection
df.loc[0, 'sales_value'] = -99999  # Canary value

# Introduce some missing values and noise
df.loc[5:10, 'sales_value'] = np.nan  # Inject missing values
noise = np.random.normal(0, 5, size=len(df))
df['sales_value'] = df['sales_value'] + noise  # Add noise to sales_value

# Save the mutated dataset
df.to_csv('dataset.csv', index=False)
